_meta.title: CompTIA A+ Basics
_meta.description: Starter pool with entry-level hardware, operating system, security, and troubleshooting questions aligned to common A+ objectives.

questions.text: Which component performs the main calculations in a computer?
questions.explanation: The CPU executes instructions and performs the primary processing tasks.

questions.text: What is a key characteristic of RAM?

answers.text: It stores data without power forever
It is only used for backups

questions.explanation: RAM is volatile, so its contents are lost when power is removed.

questions.text: Which storage device has no moving parts?
questions.explanation: Solid-state drives use flash memory instead of spinning platters.

questions.text: What is the main purpose of BIOS or UEFI firmware?

answers.text: Initialize hardware before the operating system loads
Assign IP addresses on the network

questions.explanation: BIOS or UEFI performs startup checks and prepares hardware so the OS can boot.

questions.text: What does a power supply unit do inside a desktop PC?

answers.text: Converts AC power into DC power for components

questions.explanation: A PSU converts incoming AC electricity to the DC voltages used by internal hardware.

questions.text: Which tool helps prevent electrostatic discharge damage during hardware repair?
questions.explanation: An anti-static wrist strap grounds the technician and reduces ESD risk.

questions.text: Which cable category commonly supports 10 Gbps on short runs?
questions.explanation: Cat 6 cabling supports 10 Gigabit Ethernet over shorter distances.

questions.text: What consumable does a laser printer use?
questions.explanation: Laser printers use toner powder, not ink cartridges.

questions.text: Which service automatically assigns IP addresses to client devices?
questions.explanation: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol leases IP settings to clients.

questions.text: Compared with 5 GHz Wi-Fi, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi usually provides what advantage?
questions.explanation: 2.4 GHz generally travels farther, though it often has more interference.

questions.text: Which Windows utility is commonly used to view running processes and performance data?
questions.explanation: Task Manager shows processes, resource usage, and startup items.

questions.text: What does Safe Mode do in Windows troubleshooting?

answers.text: Loads the system with minimal drivers and services

questions.explanation: Safe Mode starts Windows with only essential components to help isolate problems.

questions.text: Which Windows feature encrypts an entire drive?
questions.explanation: BitLocker provides full-disk encryption for supported Windows editions.

questions.text: A message urges a user to click a login link and verify account details immediately. What is this most likely?
questions.explanation: Phishing attempts trick users into revealing credentials or other sensitive data.

questions.text: Which option is an example of multifactor authentication?

answers.text: Two copies of the same password

questions.explanation: MFA uses different factor types, such as something you know and something you have.

questions.text: What does a VPN primarily provide for a remote worker?

answers.text: Encrypted access to a private network

questions.explanation: A VPN creates an encrypted tunnel for secure remote access.

questions.text: Which address is usually the public IP in a small office network?

answers.text: The IP on the router WAN interface
The printer IP on the LAN

questions.explanation: The public IP is typically assigned to the router or firewall interface facing the internet.

questions.text: What does the 3-2-1 backup rule recommend?

answers.text: Three copies of data, on two media types, with one offsite copy
Three passwords, two users, one admin
Three servers, two switches, one router
Three updates per week, two scans per day, one reboot

questions.explanation: The 3-2-1 rule improves backup resilience and disaster recovery readiness.

questions.text: What is the main purpose of a UPS?

answers.text: Provide battery backup during short power loss

questions.explanation: A UPS gives temporary power so equipment can stay online or shut down safely.

questions.text: Which connector is commonly used for Ethernet patch cables?
questions.explanation: RJ45 connectors are standard for twisted-pair Ethernet cabling.

questions.text: Which interface can carry both digital video and audio to a monitor or TV?
questions.explanation: HDMI transports digital video and audio over one cable.

questions.text: Which display technology is known for strong color accuracy and wide viewing angles?
questions.explanation: IPS panels are commonly chosen for better color and wider viewing angles.

questions.text: A technician resolves a user issue. What should happen next according to good support practice?

answers.text: Document the fix and close the ticket appropriately
Delete the ticket with no notes

questions.explanation: Accurate documentation supports future troubleshooting and accountability.

questions.text: Which security principle gives users only the access they need to do their job?
questions.explanation: Least privilege limits permissions to reduce risk.

questions.text: A web application looks broken after an update, but only in one browser. What is a common first troubleshooting step?
questions.explanation: Old cached files can cause display and functionality problems after updates.

questions.text: A workstation is suspected to be infected with malware. What is a good immediate action?
questions.explanation: Isolation helps stop malware from spreading while investigation begins.

questions.text: Which mobile feature lets a phone provide internet access to a laptop?
questions.explanation: A hotspot shares the phone cellular connection with other devices.

questions.text: What is the main purpose of a docking station for a laptop?

answers.text: Expand connectivity for peripherals and displays
Replace the CPU with a faster one

questions.explanation: Docking stations provide extra ports, network access, and monitor connections.

questions.text: Which file system is commonly used by modern Windows installations?
questions.explanation: NTFS is the standard Windows file system for internal drives.

questions.text: Which command-line tool can verify basic IP configuration on a Windows system?
questions.explanation: ipconfig displays local IP addressing details and related network settings.
